dialogue:
A: Did you see the shared calendar invite I sent you for the next 3 weekends?
B: Yeah, I saw him pop on my phone during my meeting. I haven't had a 2nd to look at the actual dates yet.
A: Right. Well, my parents are coming down for the 1st one. And then we have your cousin's dinner. I just need you to confirm them so I can actually plan our lives. It feels like if I don't lock you down weeks in advance, we just don't do anything together.
B: Hey, that's not fair. I've been completely swamped with a quarter, with a 3rd quarter wrap up all week. I'm not ignoring you. I'm just trying to survive my work day. You make it sound like I'm intentionally avoiding our life.
A: I'm just tired of feeling like scheduling time with my own partner as a secondary logistics project for you. It's always a battle to just get a weekend anchor down.
B: Look, I know you're stressed about your parents coming. And I want to be there for that. I'm sorry I snapped. Let me grab my laptop right now. And we can look at the blocks together. Can we just reset?
A: Okay. Yeah. Let's just look at it now.
